newsitem.title: USA: Lott sees balanced budget debate starting Feb 5.
newsitem.headline: Lott sees balanced budget debate starting Feb 5.

text.p: Senate Majority Leader Trent Lott, R-Mississippi, said Thursday he expects the Senate to begin debate on a balanced budget constitutional amendment next Wednesday, Feb. 5.

The Senate Judiciary Committee is expected to approve the amendment later this Thursday. The amendment requires a two-thirds majority in both the Senate and House in order to be sent to the states for ratification.
Several weeks of Senate debate are expected before a vote. President Clinton makes his State of the Union address to Congress on Feb. 4 and announces his budget on Feb. 6.
